skills.name: csharpessentials-any
skills.description: Use when a method returns one of several distinct types (typed outcomes, polymorphic results without a base class). Any<T0,T1> to Any<T0,...,T7> is a discriminated union. Covers implicit creation, First/Second factories, Any.Create, Match (AnyActionResult) and Switch (AnyActionStatus), IsFirst/GetFirst, Is/As/TryAs, Deconstruct/ToTuple, Partition/Traverse and JSON.

skills.name: csharpessentials-aspnetcore
skills.description: Use when wiring CSharpEssentials into ASP.NET Core. Covers AddEnhancedProblemDetails/UseEnhancedProblemDetails with GlobalExceptionHandler, ToProblemResult/ToActionResult/ToProblemDetails, typed ToHttpResult/ToCreated, ResultEndpointFilter, WithValidation, AddIdempotency/UseIdempotency/WithIdempotency/[Idempotent], WithConditionalGet/WithIfMatch, AddEnumConventions/UseEnumBinding/WithEnumWireFormat, AddAndConfigureApiVersioning/MapVersionedGroup, and the OpenAPI helpers AddEnumConventions, AddIdempotencyConventions and AddBearerSecurityScheme.

skills.name: csharpessentials-clone
skills.description: Use when domain objects need a typed copy method. Implement ICloneable<T> (T Clone()) from CSharpEssentials.Clone on a class, then call Clone() on an IEnumerable<T> or IQueryable<T> to copy every item. The copy depth is whatever your Clone() does.

skills.name: csharpessentials-core
skills.description: Use for small C# helpers from CSharpEssentials.Core. String case conversion (ToSnakeCase, ToPascalCase, ToKebabCase), GUIDs (Guider.NewGuid version 7, NewMonotonicGuid, NewSqlServerGuid, NewGuidV5, ToStringFromGuid/ToGuidFromString), collection helpers (IfAdd, WhereIf, WithoutNulls, HasSameElements, GetRandomItems), null and bool helpers (IsEmpty, IfNotNull, IfTrue), IsBetween, WithCancellation, HttpCodes and the ITransactionRunner/ITransactionCallbacks interfaces.

skills.name: csharpessentials-dependencyinjection
skills.description: Use when registering services by attribute instead of manual AddScoped calls or Scrutor scanning. Covers [RegisterSingleton], [RegisterScoped], [RegisterTransient] (Key, As = ServiceAs.*, Strategy = RegistrationStrategy.*), [Decorates] and services.Decorate/TryDecorate, [ExcludeFromRegistration], the generated services.AddAllServices() and services.Add{Asm}Services() registry, AddServicesFromAssemblies, and diagnostics CSE2001 to CSE2009.

skills.name: csharpessentials-efcore
skills.description: Use when writing EF Core code with CSharpEssentials. Covers AddAuditInterceptor, BaseDbContext (InterceptorsFromServices, DispatchDomainEventsOnSaveChanges), DomainEventInterceptor, soft delete filters and SoftDeleteAsync, PaginateAsync and KeysetPaginateAsync, *AsResultAsync, AddEfCoreTransactionRunner, the outbox (AddEfCoreOutbox, AddOutboxProcessor), DbErrorTranslation, Maybe<T>? and [StringEnum] columns, plus the HealthChecks (AddMigrationsCheck), Hosting (AddOutboxProcessorHostedService) and Locking (AddRelationalResourceLock) packages.

skills.name: csharpessentials-endpoints
skills.description: Use when organizing ASP.NET Core Minimal API endpoints into classes with CSharpEssentials.Endpoints. Covers IEndpoint and IEndpointGroup with static members, [EndpointGroup<T>] nesting, [ExcludeFromMapping], the generated app.MapAllEndpoints() and app.Map{Asm}Endpoints() registry, EndpointMappingOptions (Filter, ConfigureEach, OperationNaming, AutoTagFromGroup), RouteOf<T>, RequireRoles, RequirePolicies, RequireAuthSchemes, MapEndpointsFromAssemblies, and diagnostics CSE1001 to CSE1013.

skills.name: csharpessentials-entity
skills.description: Use when writing DDD entities or aggregate roots. Covers EntityBase/EntityBase<TId> (audit fields via SetCreatedInfo/SetUpdatedInfo, domain events via Raise/DomainEvents/ClearDomainEvents), SoftDeletableEntityBase<TId> (MarkAsDeleted/Restore/MarkAsHardDeleted, HardDelete()), the DomainEvent record (EventId, OccurredAt from a TimeProvider), IDomainEvent and [DomainEventTiming(BeforeSave|AfterSave)].

skills.name: csharpessentials-enums
skills.description: Use when an enum crosses a boundary (JSON, ASP.NET Core binding, OpenAPI, EF Core, HTTP) and needs one string spelling, or for reflection-free enum helpers. Covers [StringEnum], [EnumAlias], [EnumFallback], EnumNaming, the generated {Enum}Extensions (ToWireName, TryParseWire, ParseWire, IsDefined, ToDescription, Names, Values), EnumConventions, EnumReadMode, EnumValueParser, EnumValueFormatter, EnumMetadata, flags, safe renames and analyzers CSE0002-CSE0016.

skills.name: csharpessentials-errors
skills.description: Use when creating error values for Result returns, error catalogs or HTTP status mapping. Covers Error factories (Validation, NotFound, Conflict, Unauthorized, Forbidden, Domain, Failure, Unexpected, Exception, Create), ErrorMetadata.AddMetadata, ErrorType.ToHttpStatusCode/ToErrorType, typed kinds (NotFoundError, ConflictError, ValidationError, ...) with ToError and [ErrorKind], and DomainException/EnhancedValidationException.

skills.name: csharpessentials-gcpsecretmanager
skills.description: Use when loading Google Cloud Secret Manager secrets into IConfiguration at startup. Covers builder.Configuration.AddGcpSecretManager with AddProject(new ProjectSecretConfiguration { ProjectId, PrefixFilters, SecretIds, RawSecretIds, RawSecretPrefixes, Region }) or the "GoogleSecretManager" appsettings section, SecretManagerConfigurationOptions (CredentialsPath, BatchSize, PageSize, LoggerFactory, Loader), the __ to : key mapping, JSON secret flattening, custom ISecretManagerConfigurationLoader and transient gRPC retries.

skills.name: csharpessentials-http
skills.description: Use when calling HTTP APIs that should return Result or Result<T> instead of throwing. Covers GetFromJsonAsResultAsync, PostAsJsonAsResultAsync, PutAsJsonAsResultAsync, PatchAsJsonAsResultAsync, DeleteAsResultAsync, SendAsResultAsync, HttpRequestBuilder, WithQueryString, HttpStatusCodeMapper, SendWithRedirectsAsResultAsync, CreateResiliencePolicy, Idempotency-Key helpers (SetIdempotencyKey, WithIdempotencyKey, IdempotencyKeyHandler, RetryUnsafeMethodsOnlyWithIdempotencyKey) and the AddSsrfGuard client for user-supplied URLs.

skills.name: csharpessentials-idempotency
skills.description: Use when an operation must run once per key and caller, or a retry or message redelivery must not repeat a side effect, outside HTTP and Mediator or under them. Covers AddIdempotencyExecutor, IIdempotencyExecutor.ExecuteAsync with IdempotencyRecordKey, codecs and profiles, IdempotencyInbox.ProcessAsync, IIdempotencyRecordStore (in-memory, distributed cache, EF Core, custom), IdempotencyScope and IdempotencyScopes, IdempotencyKeys.For/FromMessage/ToUuidV5, Observe to Enforce rollout and the idempotency.decisions counter.

skills.name: csharpessentials-json
skills.description: Use when configuring System.Text.Json with CSharpEssentials.Json. EnhancedJsonSerializerOptions presets (DefaultOptions, StrictOptions, Create, ApplyTo), ConvertToJson/ConvertFromJson, AddEnumConventions for [StringEnum] enums, polymorphism with [JsonPolymorphic] + [JsonTypeDiscriminator] and AddPolymorphism (AOT safe) or AddPolymorphismWithReflection, [JsonPolymorphicProperty], RequireValueTypeConstructorParameters, MultiFormatDateTimeConverterFactory, JsonElement.ToClrObject and analyzers CSE4001-CSE4012.

skills.name: csharpessentials-logging
skills.description: Use when logging HTTP request and response bodies in ASP.NET Core with CSharpEssentials.RequestResponseLogging. Covers app.AddRequestResponseLogging(opt => ...) with UseLogger(ILoggerFactory, LoggingOptions), LoggingOptions.CreateAllFields(), LogFields, HeaderKeys, UseHandler(Func<RequestResponseContext, Task>), IgnorePaths, and the [SkipRequestLogging], [SkipResponseLogging] and [SkipRequestResponseLogging] attributes.

skills.name: csharpessentials-maybe
skills.description: Use when a value may be missing and callers must handle it (lookups, optional fields, first-or-none). Maybe<T> is an option type. Covers implicit creation, Maybe.None/From/FromTry, AsMaybe, HasValue, GetValueOrDefault, Map/Bind/Where/Or, LINQ syntax, Match, Tap/TapNone, ToResult(error)/ToMaybeResult, TryFirst/TryFind/Choose/Sequence/Traverse/Partition and the *Async chain.

skills.name: csharpessentials-mediator
skills.description: Use when adding pipeline behaviors to Mediator (martinothamar, source generator, not MediatR) CQRS handlers that return Result or Result<T>. Covers AddMediatorBehaviors, ValidationBehavior (Enforce/LogOnly/Off, IValidationFailureObserver), LoggingBehavior (IRequestLoggable), ExceptionHandlingBehavior, CachingBehavior (ICacheable), TransactionScopeBehavior and TransactionBehavior (ITransactionalRequest, ITransactionRunner), LockBehavior (ILockedRequest, IResourceLock) and IdempotencyBehavior (IIdempotentRequest, AddMediatorIdempotencyBehavior).

skills.name: csharpessentials-meta
skills.description: Use when choosing which CSharpEssentials package solves a problem, or when a project references the CSharpEssentials meta-package. Maps all 32 packages to the problems they solve and their skills, lists what the meta-package bundles, and covers its own helpers JsonElement.TryGetProperty, JsonDocument.TryGetNestedProperty and long?.MsToDateTime.

skills.name: csharpessentials-resilience
skills.description: Use when adding retry, timeout, circuit breaker or fallback around code that returns Result or Result<T>. Covers ResiliencePolicy and ResiliencePolicy<T> (Create, WithRetry, WithTimeout, WithCircuitBreaker, WithFallback, ExecuteAsync, FromPipeline, ToPipeline), ResiliencePolicyOptions with RetryOptions, TimeoutOptions and CircuitBreakerOptions, RetryIfFailed with an optional shouldRetry predicate, which error types are retried, and caller cancellation that throws OperationCanceledException. Built on Polly.Core v8.

skills.name: csharpessentials-results
skills.description: Use when a method can fail in expected ways and should return the failure instead of throwing. Covers Result and Result<T> (implicit returns, Then/Map/Bind/Ensure chains, Match/Switch, Else/Compensate/Recover, Result.Try, Combine/CombineAll/Traverse), the *Async forms on Task and ValueTask sources, and typed Result<T, E1..E3> with Match, BindWiden, JSON and the CSE5001-CSE5006 analyzers.

skills.name: csharpessentials-rules
skills.description: Use when composing business rules that return Result or Result<T>. Covers IRule<T>/IAsyncRule<T> classes, Func rules, RuleEngine.FromPredicate/FromPredicateAsync, .ToRule(), .And()/.Or()/.Linear()/.Next(), RuleEngine.If, the static RuleEngine.And/Or/Linear shortcuts, RuleEngine.Evaluate and EvaluateAsync, value rules (IRule<TContext,TResult>) and custom ILinearRule/IConditionalRule/IAndRule/IOrRule nodes.

skills.name: csharpessentials-these
skills.description: Use when a result can succeed with a warning (partial success, capped values, batch imports). These<TError, TValue> is Left (error), Right (value) or Both. Covers the Left/Right/Both factories, IsLeft/IsRight/IsBoth, Match, Map, MapLeft, FlatMap, Tap, TapLeft, GetRight/GetLeft (Maybe<T>), TheseExtensions.FromResult, ToResult/ToResultLenient and Partition.

skills.name: csharpessentials-time
skills.description: Use when code needs a testable clock. Inject IDateTimeProvider from CSharpEssentials.Time (DateTimeProvider over TimeProvider.System in production; FakeDateTimeProvider with Advance/SetTime, or DateTimeProvider over FakeTimeProvider, in tests). Also TimeZones.Find/TryFind for IANA or Windows ids, NowIn/TodayIn for a user's zone, GetAge, NextDayOfWeek/PreviousDayOfWeek and ToDateOnly/ToTimeOnly.

skills.name: csharpessentials-validation
skills.description: Use when writing model validation that returns Result<T>, or migrating from FluentValidation. Covers Validator<T>.Configure(model, rules, ct), rules.For(() => model.X) with NotEmpty/MaxLength/EmailAddress/GreaterThan/InclusiveBetween/IsDefinedEnum/MinCount, Must/MustAsync, SetValidatorAsync, ForEach/ForEachAsync, CascadeMode, Include, Order, AddValidator/AddValidatorsFromAssembly and ValidateWith/ValidateWithAsync.
